title: Sr Director, Fulfillment and Distribution Center Operations
text:
Why Join ADI?

At ADI, our distribution network is much more than a collection of warehouses. It is a critical competitive advantage and one of the primary drivers of our customer experience. As the Senior Director of Distribution Center Operations, you will lead a geographically dispersed network of distribution centers that serves thousands of customers across North America. This role is responsible for ensuring every facility operates safely, efficiently, and consistently while delivering exceptional service levels that support our branches, sales teams, and customers. This is a highly visible leadership position that sits at the intersection of Operations, Supply Chain, Customer Service, Sales, Finance, Human Resources, and Digital Transformation. You will shape the future of ADI's distribution network through operational excellence, continuous improvement, technology adoption, workforce engagement, and strategic network initiatives. We're looking for a leader who thrives in fast-paced environments, embraces complex operational challenges, and understands that every shipment, every inventory decision, and every associate interaction ultimately impacts the customer experience.

**Job Description**

What You'll Own

* Lead all aspects of distribution center operations across ADI's North American network, ensuring safe, scalable, and customer-focused execution.
* Establish a culture where safety, engagement, accountability, and continuous improvement are foundational expectations.
* Drive network performance across key operational metrics including service levels, productivity, quality, inventory accuracy, fulfillment speed, receiving performance, and cost efficiency.
* Partner closely with Sales, Customer Service, Supply Chain, Merchandising, and Digital Transformation teams to improve customer experience and deliver industry leading service. • Develop and execute strategies that improve operational performance while supporting long-term business growth.
* Lead and develop a team of distribution center leaders, creating a high performance culture built on accountability, talent development, and succession planning.
* Ensure staffing, labor planning, equipment strategies, and capacity models to support current and future business requirements.
* Champion Business Excellence principles across the network while driving sustainable process standardization and continuous improvement programs.
* Lead large-scale operational transformation initiatives, including warehouse management systems, automation, labor optimization, and process redesign projects.
* Partner on network optimization initiatives including facility expansion, consolidation, new site implementation, and network design strategy.
* Drive best-in-class inventory management practices that improve inventory accuracy while supporting customer service and working capital objectives.
* Utilize operational data, analytics, and technology to identify opportunities to improve service, productivity, quality, and cost performance.
* Develop and manage operating budgets, capital investment plans, and long-range operational strategies.
* Build strong relationships with key suppliers, equipment providers, transportation partners, and service organizations that support distribution operations.
* Serve as a senior operational leader during periods of rapid growth, supply disruption, major business initiatives, and peak-volume events.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Customers receive the right product at the right time with exceptional consistency.
* Distribution centers operate safely while maintaining world-class productivity and quality.
* Inventory accuracy supports both customer satisfaction and strong financial performance.
* Teams are engaged, developed, and empowered to solve problems at the source.
* The network continuously evolves through automation, technology, and process improvement.
* ADI maintains a scalable distribution platform capable of supporting future growth.

**YOU MUST HAVE**

* 10+ years of progressive distribution, fulfillment, logistics, or supply chain leadership experience.
* Experience leading multi-site distribution operations within a complex, high-volume network.
* Demonstrated success managing large teams through multiple layers of leadership.
* Strong knowledge of warehouse operations, inventory management, labor planning, transportation, and fulfillment processes.
* Experience driving significant operational improvements across productivity, service, quality, safety, and cost metrics.
* Experience leading large-scale change initiatives including WMS implementations, network transformations, automation projects, or facility start-ups.
* Strong financial acumen with experience managing operating budgets, labor plans, and capital investments.
* Proven ability to build cross-functional partnerships and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
* Willingness to travel regularly throughout the distribution network.

**WE VALUE**

* Experience in change management and creating buy-in.
* Enjoyment from being collaborative and hands-on; comfortable balancing tactical execution with strategic initiatives.
* A leadership style with continuous improvement at its core.
* A history of thriving in a fast-paced and often ambiguous environment.
* A self-starter personality who maps their own direction to succeed.

**WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU**

* Be a part of the #1 Global Distribution Team
* Leverage your expertise to build and improve ADI's culture and processes.
* Benefits Day 1, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with company match, paid vacation, sick time, and company holidays.
